folds.heading: ## Native-audit reconciliation: exact semantics and structural proof (B250, 2026-11-04)
folds.body:
F1. Four complete UI audit/checkpoint reads add the native semantics that names and screenshots cannot establish. R7 F1–F32 traces the active renderer: inspecting is not attack retargeting, hero_missed does not itself determine English direction, AP/EP ratings are not direct hit percentages, rounded HP is not exact bar state, and cycle is not guaranteed time-to-hit. Shield Block's compound stat_value_long needs the same actual projection as ordinary stat values. Dormant legacy formulas are not current combat defects. Native compatibility disclosure is not accepted universal appraisal under AD32; actual observer means still qualify new facts.

F2. R7's Clear route resets category counts and dynamic-loot references alongside nodes. Stop combat log is presentation-scoped suppression while gameplay continues, with no replay backlog or persistent event store. Passive previews cannot intercept unrelated clicks, and stable native event subjects survive inspection/rename/context changes. A3600×1906 attachment does not establish CSS viewport/DPR; fit-image blur is not native text quality. Final selected-item zero-height and completion-hook fixes are scoped behavior/harness findings, not startup or sustained throughput measurements. Later named More panels routes qualify the earlier no-catch-all recommendation rather than freezing one historic navigation composition.

F3. R17's structural identity proof deliberately uses the separately identified R17a fit-ratchet correction on both sides: R16+R17a versus R17+R17a9/9. It does not prove final code is pixel-identical to untouched R16. The initial no-build.js scope was explicitly amended for one stylesheet version line. Preview real village/current-work panels are distinct from labelled display/proto placeholders; a passing fixture/import-side-effect check is not proof every runtime panel mounts purely. Keep source data/spec, measuring host, registry and sole mover separate without introducing another layout controller. AD36/AD43 retain exact compared inputs and proof limits.

F4. R20's initial band plan was extended with grouping after the eight-opponent capture cut facts off; its final report owns actual layout/results, not the original thresholds alone. R21 is a saved-before-edit one-bar/control-box/placement plan, not a passing gate record. Its stable width folding, Esc-before-Back, outside-click consumption, real moved handlers and per-context browser preference/reset remain useful contracts. Later R22c's spec2 placement fix qualifies R22b migration claims. Game-save byte comparison does not make browser-local arrangement part of the gameplay transport, and current save-state mirror does not supply a last-saved clock. AD42 keeps review optional, current desktop/prose-first direction qualifies old targets, and old reservations/commit/send requests are history rather than renewed authority.
